Register to Vote ID Requirements View District Maps Voter Resources
General

Regular General Election

Ballots Mailed October 13, 2026
Request Ballot By October 27, 2026 by 5pm
Election Day November 3, 2026

Active registered voters will receive a ballot in the mail automatically. Return by mail or drop box.

Track My Ballot Check Voter Registration Status

In odd numbered years, Utah holds municipal elections, including most special district elections. Federal, state, and county elections occur in even numbered years. The lieutenant governor is the election official for all statewide elections and the county clerk of each county is the election official for elections in that county. 20A-1-102(26)(a) & (b)

For more information regarding the 2026 elections, please contact your designated election official.
certification_pages:
OFFICE OF THE LIEUTENANT GOVERNOR
2026 GENERAL ELECTION CERTIFICATION
I, Deidre M. Henderson, Lieutenant Governor of the State of Utah, do hereby certify that:
1. Pursuant to Utah Code Annotated§ 20A-5a-209(2)(a), candidates whose names appear on the
attached list are qualified for placement and shall appear on the 2026 General Election ballot;
and,
2. Pursuant to Utah Code Annotated§ 20A-5a-209(2)(b), candidates' names shall appear on the
2026 General Election ballot as written and in the order listed on the attached list; and,
3. Pursuant to Utah Code Annotated§ 20A-12-201(3)(a), the names of the following judicial offices
subject to retention election shall appear on the 2026 General Election ballot; and,
4. Pursuant to Utah Code Annotated§ 20A-5a-209(2)(c), no statewide ballot propositions have
qualified for placement on the 2026 Utah General Election ballot; and,
5. Pursuant to Utah Code Annotated§ 20A-7-103(4), the following proposed constitutional
amendments as passed by the Utah State Legislature shall appear on the 2026 General Election
ballot; and,
6. Pursuant to Utah Code Annotated§ 20A-8-106(2)(b), the following official political parties are
currently registered in Utah; and,
7. Pursuant to Utah Code Annotated§ 20A-5a-210, a county clerk shall publish the required notice
for the county, as a class A notice, for 30 calendar days, no earlier than Monday, August 31, 2026,
and no later than Wednesday, September 2, 2026.
IN WITNESS WHEREOF, I have hereunto
set my hand and affixed the Great Seal of
the State of Utah at Salt Lake City, this 28th
day of August, 2026.
Deidre M. Henderson
Lieutenant Governor

PROPOSED CONSTITUTIONAL AMENDMENTS
Constitutional Amendment A.
Shall the Utah Constitution be amended to change how proposed constitutional amendments are
published, requiring publication for 60 days immediately before the general election in a manner
established by state law instead of in newspapers?
If voters approve Constitutional Amendment A, state statute would change to require the Lieutenant
Governor to publish the full text of all proposed constitutional amendments and other ballot questions
from the Legislature, on the Utah Public Notice Website and on the Lieutenant Governor's website for 60
days immediately before the general election.
() For () Against
Constitutional Amendment B.
Shall the Utah Constitution be amended to require that citizen-proposed laws that increase taxes
compared to existing law be approved by at least 60% of voters, instead of a simple majority?
